name: Aaloo Ke Kufri Chipsona-1 Prabhed Ke Kshetra Vistaar Yojana
benefit: - **Affordable High-Quality Seeds:** Farmers will receive Kufri Chipsona-I potato seeds at an estimated price of ₹4,000/- per quintal or the actual seed price, whichever is lower. - **Financial Assistance:** Total ₹93,863/- per hectare (First year: ₹70,397/- and Second year: ₹23,466/-).
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
   1. The applicant should be a farmer.
   1. The applicant must have agricultural land a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 5 acres (2 ha).
   1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.

&lt;br&gt;

&gt; **Note 1:  Beneficiary allocation:**

    - General Category: 78.56%.
    - Scheduled Castes: 20%.
    - Scheduled Tribes: 1.44%.
    - Women Participation: 30%.

&gt; **Note 2:** The benefits of this scheme can be taken by ryot farmers on the basis of land documents and non-ryot farmers on the basis of contract form.

&gt; **Note 3:** Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.
